messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming/generate p99 tail latency jumped to ~3.8s (baseline 0.9s) across us-west-2-gpupool. Error rate stable. Auto-alert: paging oncall.
Mia (oncall): acked, i'm on it. starting triage. any recent deploys or config changes?
Samir (SRE): I see a sharp uptick starting ~1717234200 (15m ago). p95 also up but less severe. tracing shows spikes concentrated on requests hitting int8-compiled model shards.
Nina (ML Infra): we rolled int8 calibration profile for 'redwood-open-35b' from canary to 100% ~20m ago. calibration job finished then.
Jordy (Eng-runtime): noted. streaming codepath uses KV-cache + dequant. suspect dequant path interacting with long-context caching.
Mia (oncall): ok primary hypothesis: int8 calibration rollout caused dequant kink for some input lengths -> tail stalls. scope: only streaming/generate, not embeddings.
Aisha (Support): we've received 3 customer tickets mentioning long stalls in streaming chat (timeouts around 5-10s). CS flagged two high-visibility customers.
Samir (SRE): can we toggle routing to fp16 variant while we investigate? that should restore tail.
Jordy (Eng-runtime): we have a traffic-split route. flipping to fp16 should be safe. rolling command: ```
# flip route to fp16 variant
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/routes/split" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"streaming","model":"redwood-open-35b","variant":"fp16","pct":100}'
```
Mia (oncall): Samir, can you run that? I'll coordinate CS and watch metrics.
Samir (SRE): running now. DeployBot: kick route split.
DeployBot: route-split job started (job id: rs-20240331-11).
Samir (SRE): route split returned success. traffic now on fp16. metrics in grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/streaming/latency?from=now-30m
Mia (oncall): watching p99… starting to decline. p99 down from 3.8s -> 1.1s in next 3 min. :white_check_mark:
Nina (ML Infra): good. we should rollback the calibration profile and mark the int8 build investigated. I'll open a rollback for calibration in the config store.
Jordy (Eng-runtime): also recommend temporarily disabling dequant optimization for long-context (>2048) in the int8 runtime until we root cause. small config patch: `RUNTIME_DISABLE_DEQUANT_LONG_CTX=true`
Samir (SRE): opened rollback PR for calibration, will apply after approval. for now traffic on fp16 so customer impact minimized.
Aisha (Support): pinging customers, telling them we routed them to an fp16 fallback and investigating. will update high-touch accounts.
Mia (oncall): quick checklist: 1) keep fp16 fallback for 2h 2) collect sample traces for offending requests 3) correlate with cache evictions + KV latencies 4) postmortem. Assigning owners: Nina -> calibration rollback + analysis, Jordy -> runtime dequant investigations, Samir -> routing + SLO rollback communication, Mia -> incident lead and customer updates.
Nina (ML Infra): collecting calibration artifacts now. I see slight mismatch in quant scales for attention QK for tokens > 1024. saving traces to s3://prod-artifacts/calib-traces/1717234567/
Jordy (Eng-runtime): capturing runtime logs for dequant hops: `grep DEQUANT /var/log/runtime/* | grep 171723` then uploading to same s3 bucket.
Samir (SRE): creating incident page: https://incidents.redwood/1717234567. Adding metrics screenshots and ticket notes.
Mia (oncall): ETA for deeper fix?
Nina (ML Infra): early guess: calibration routine accepted an outlier batch that skewed per-tensor scales. need to re-run calib with stricter OOB filtering. might take 3-4 hours to repro locally and validate.
Jordy (Eng-runtime): in parallel I'll add a guard to skip int8 dequant path when per-layer scale variance > 2x to avoid stalls; quick patch could land in 1-2 hours.
Aisha (Support): CS updated customers, they acknowledged the temporary fallback. no escalations for outage; they want a postmortem.
Mia (oncall): ok moving to recovery/monitoring. maintain fp16 route and start SLO exception docs. Anyone taking handoff for next shift? I'm on for 45m then handing to Samir.
Samir (SRE): happy to take next shift. Mia, add me as primary in incident page.
DeployBot: route-split job completed at 1717235320.
Mia (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. will keep channel open for follow-ups. please attach all artifacts to the incident page.
Nina (ML Infra): uploading calib artifacts and initial diffs. link: https://s3.console.aws/.../calib-traces/1717234567/
Jordy (Eng-runtime): uploading runtime patches to review: https://phabricator.internal/D3421
Samir (SRE): setting a monitoring alert to detect similar calibration ramps in future and a guard to auto-fallback to fp16 if p99 > 2s for 5m.
Mia (oncall): thanks team. Postmortem tentatively scheduled tomorrow 10:30 PT. tagging owners. closing thread for active paging, will reopen if regression. :eyes:
